correctness.rationale: For Q equal to the integrated squared standard Brownian bridge, conditional Gaussian regression and total variance give risk equal to the prior risk 1/45 minus twice the squared Hilbert–Schmidt norm of the covariance of the conditional mean. For distinct interior knots the conditional mean is the piecewise linear interpolant; its covariance uses the two tent functions, whose Gram matrix has diagonal y/3 and (1-x)/3 and off-diagonal (y-x)/6. This independently gives the half-reliability risks 697/61740 at (3/7,4/7) and 17/1440 for repeated midpoint attempts, which supply a single exact midpoint value with probability 3/4. Endpoints and repetitions are covered by the corresponding reduced conditioning set (or zero-length bridge cells). A separate exact-symbolic reproduction checked the cell integrals, independent-erasure mixture and the global polynomial certificates. At d <= 1/4 the offset penalty is strictly positive for any nonzero offset, by the affine-in-p edge bound; for d >= 1/4 the fixed-offset spacing derivative is positive in the interior since D0 is nonnegative and convex D1 has negative endpoint slope and positive endpoint value. This excludes the large-spacing boundary by strict increase and continuity. On the centered segment the sign changes once at the positive root of (24p+16)d²+(8-6p)d-p, which is the displayed radical. The inverse p(d) is increasing and the p=0 tie and p=1 endpoint are as stated.
residual_risks: The proof applies only to the stated scalar squared-error loss, fixed knots, exact observations and equal independent delivery probabilities.

checked_sources: RESULT.md, Finding and global optimization proof
value.rationale: This resolves the natural redundancy-versus-spacing decision for two fallible exact attempts to measure a nonlinear path functional. The optimal sites do not merely interpolate two known design points: they are distinct for every p>0, separate monotonically, and are globally optimal even when coincidences and endpoints are allowed. This is useful exact information about when replication is suboptimal; the rational example is a check, not the basis for value.
residual_risks: No conclusions for adaptive, unequal-reliability or noisy sensing.
